title: Spotify Track Explorer
summary: Compare track popularity, release patterns and audio characteristics.
features: Audio-feature cards, including danceability, acousticness and valence
limitations: Release dates describe music releases, not daily listening activity. The preview reflects one saved selection; it is not a live dashboard.

title: Business Insight 360
summary: Explore finance, sales, marketing and supply-chain performance.
features: Supply chain: forecast accuracy, net error and risk
limitations: The file contains four analytical pages plus a home page. An Executive View is not included. The report is a portfolio exercise; company branding does not establish a client relationship.

title: Apple Product Performance
summary: Compare product sales, quantities and year-over-year performance.
limitations: This Apple-product-themed portfolio report is not official Apple financial reporting. Dataset source and currency still need confirmation before numerical findings are published.

title: Product Order Fulfilment
summary: Explore delivered, returned, lost and back-ordered products.
features: Home-page navigation to the analysis page
Delivered, returned, lost and back-order views
limitations: Quantities, order counts and line totals are distinct measures. Status percentages need a consistent denominator; distinct-order calculations require a Desktop check.
